answer: Each AI agent runs inside a unique TEE whose boot‑loader measures a hardware‑bound key signed by a trusted Juniper root, then publishes a signed attestation that the network verifies against a Dune‑maintained registry; the registry only accepts one active plume per key, rejecting any duplicate submissions. When a node attempts to spawn a second identity it must acquire a fresh hardware key, which costs the market price of a dedicated TEE device (≈ $350) plus a 48‑hour lock‑up of the key’s escrowed stake.
